title: Quieter Stone Pressure Plates
description: Turn down the volume of Stone and Blackstone Pressure Plates!
body:
The Quieter Stone Pressure Plates Resource Pack adds lowers the volume of Stone and Blackstone to be less noticable when activating!

It is themed around Colonal's love of Pink Slime, and optimized for to be used in the Colonal Mod Pack (CMP).
